text: 海通国际发报告指，下调老铺黄金(6181.HK)目标价21%至435港元，维持“优于大市”评级。该行预估公司2026—2028年收入分别为322.55/302.63/328.96亿元人民币，同比变动18.1%/—6.2%/8.7%；经调整净利润分别为68.23/64.43/71.27亿元；经调整净利润为3.16%/5%/10.106%/5.6%。考虑到高基数、消费环境偏弱及金价波动带来的经营不确定性，下调目标价但维持评级。
text_en: Haitong International issued a report lowering its target price for Laopu Gold (6181.HK) by 21% to HK$435, maintaining an 'outperform' rating. The firm estimates the company's 2026-2028 revenue at 32.255/30.263/32.896 billion yuan, changing 18.1%/-6.2%/8.7% year on year; adjusted net profit at 6.823/6.443/7.127 billion yuan; adjusted net margin at 3.16%/5%/10.106%/5.6%. Considering the high base, weak consumption environment and operational uncertainty brought by gold price volatility, it lowered the target price but maintained the rating.
